survey.title: Chocolate Consumer Preferences Survey
survey.description: Collects data on chocolate preferences, buying habits, brand loyalty, and satisfaction for market analysis.
survey.welcome_text: Welcome! Thank you for taking a few minutes to share your chocolate preferences. Your responses are confidential and will help improve chocolate products and services.
survey.end_text: Thank you for completing the survey! We appreciate your insights on chocolate preferences.
survey.request:
Prompt: Chocolate Consumer Survey

Create an interactive, user-friendly chocolate survey designed for a tablet screen. The survey should collect information about consumers’ chocolate preferences, buying habits, favorite brands, and satisfaction levels.

Include the following questions:

What is your age group?
How often do you eat chocolate?
Which type of chocolate do you prefer?
Milk chocolate
Dark chocolate
White chocolate
Chocolate with nuts or caramel
What is your favorite chocolate brand?
How much do you usually spend on chocolate?
Where do you usually buy chocolate?
What factors influence your chocolate purchase?
Taste
Price
Brand
Packaging
Quality
How satisfied are you with your favorite chocolate brand? (Rate from 1 to 5.)
Would you try a new chocolate brand if it offered a unique flavor?
What improvements or new flavors would you like to see in chocolate products?

Design requirements:

Use a clean, attractive, chocolate-themed design.
Make the survey fully responsive for tablet screens.
Use large buttons, readable fonts, and simple navigation.
Include multiple-choice questions, rating scales, and an optional text response.
Display a progress bar and Back/Next buttons.
Show a thank-you message after submission.
Keep the survey short enough to complete in 2–3 minutes.
Store responses in a structured format for analysis and reporting.
